mapper.select: SELECT p.post_id, p.company_code, c.name AS company_name, p.member_id, m.nickname, p.title, p.content, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM post p JOIN company c ON c.code = p.company_code JOIN member m ON m.member_id = p.member_id WHERE p.post_id = #{postId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post (company_code, member_id, title, content) VALUES (#{companyCode}, #{memberId}, #{title}, #{content})
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE post_id = #{postId}
